Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT A FREIGHT TRAIN HAD (20) CARS AND (1) LOCOMOTIVE THAT DERAILED AFTER STRIKING A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK AT A GRADE CROSSING. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT THE CONDUCTOR IS COMPLAINING OF BRUISED RIBS AND THE DRIVER OF THE TRUCK SUSTAINED UNSPECIFIED INJURIES. BOTH PARTIES WERE TRANSPORTED TO A LOCAL HOSPITAL FOR TREATMENT. ACCORDING TO THE CALLER (19) OF THE TWENTY CARS THAT DERAILED WERE EMPTY, HOWEVER THE 20TH CAR WAS LOADED WITH RAILWAY EQUIPMENT. CURRENTLY IT IS UNKNOWN IF THE TRACTOR TRAILER RELEASED ANY MATERIAL DURING THIS INCIDENT. THERE WERE DAMAGES, HOWEVER THE PRICE POINT FOR THOSE DAMAGES IS STILL UNKNOWN TO THE CALLER.

Medium Affected: NON-RELEASE (N/A)

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.044212, -75.127298 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTED A COLLISION OF VEHICLES WHILE CLEARING AN INTERLOCKING AREA. THE BALLAST REGULATOR MADE IT THROUGH THE INTERLOCKING SAFELY AND WAS WAITING FOR A DUMP TRUCK TO COME THROUGH. AFTER THE DUMP TRUCK CLEARED THE INTERLOCKING, THE DUMP TRUCK DRIVER REALIZED THE BRAKES WERE NOT CATCHING DUE TO EXTREMELY WET WEATHER CONDITIONS. THE DRIVER BEGAN BLOWING THE HORN FOR AWARENESS AND CLEARANCE. AT THIS TIME, THE REGULATOR ATTEMPTED TO PROVIDE CLEARANCE BUT WAS NOT ABLE TO CLEAR ENOUGH SPACE TO AVOID COLLISION. AS A RESULT, A COLLISION OCCURRED AND THE REGULATOR ARM GOT WEDGED INTO THE DUMP TRUCK FRONT BUMPER. CALLER EMPHASIZED EXTREME ADVERSE WEATHER CONDITIONS; A HEAVY DOWN POUR WAS OCCURRING AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT WHICH, THE CALLER STATED, ULTIMATELY CAUSED THE INCIDENT.
